change_request.title: Enable PPL fillnull on the analytics-engine route via DataFusion COALESCE
change_request.author: ahkcs

task.task: Enable PPL fillnull on the analytics-engine route using DataFusion’s native COALESCE and CEIL support, including nested scalar expressions.
subtasks: Add STANDARD_PROJECT_OPS containing COALESCE and CEIL to DataFusionAnalyticsBackendPlugin, and expose project capabilities across the backend’s supported field types and formats.

Update OpenSearchProject.stripAnnotations to recursively remove nested AnnotatedProjectExpression wrappers with a RexShuttle after resolving each top-level annotation, preserving the supplied annotation resolver.
Add a ProjectRuleTests regression test using PLUS(CEIL(value), value) to verify nested annotations are produced and completely removed before Substrait conversion.
Add self-contained FillNullCommandIT coverage through POST /_analytics/ppl using a parquet-backed calcs dataset provisioned once per class, without SQL-plugin dependencies.

Cover all 13 integration cases: single- and multiple-field replacements, per-field values, field references, nested CEIL replacements, chained fillnull commands, value= syntax, string replacements, BIGINT-to-INTEGER numeric coercion, and incompatible-type errors. Assert returned rows with numeric-type-tolerant comparisons.
Verify the planner regression tests and all 13 REST integration tests pass without Rust, FragmentConvertor, or Substrait-extension changes.

change_request.title: Prevent criteria update for context aware indices
change_request.author: RS146BIJAY

task.task: Prevent updates to document grouping criteria in context-aware indices while allowing recreation after deletion, simplifying version management across IndexWriters.
subtasks: Validate incoming grouping criteria against the current and old criteria maps in CompositeIndexWriter during version resolution; reject changes with UnsupportedOperationException and the message "Updating grouping criteria is not allowed for context aware enabled indices." Ignore missing criteria associated with tombstones.

Extend VersionsAndSeqNoResolver.loadDocIdAndVersion to accept optional incoming criteria and compare them against the existing document segment's CriteriaBasedCodec.BUCKET_NAME attribute for positive document versions. Update callers to pass criteria for indexing and null when validation is unnecessary.
Add the immutable-field validation hook to DocumentIndexWriter, with a no-op implementation for LuceneIndexWriter so ordinary indices remain unaffected.
Remove CompositeIndexWriter's per-UID keyed lock and related assertions and test wrappers while retaining writer-map locking.

Add engine regression tests for rejecting grouping-criteria changes and allowing changed criteria when recreating a deleted document after refresh. Parameterize the context-specific document test helper and update affected tests.
Add a changelog entry documenting the fix.

change_request.title: Fix StringView buffer bloat in stream_next FFI export
change_request.author: bowenlan-amzn

task.task: Prevent sliced StringView and BinaryView batches from exporting oversized backing buffers through stream_next's Arrow FFI boundary.
subtasks: Cache whether the stream schema contains top-level Utf8View or BinaryView columns in both QueryStreamHandle constructors, and skip compaction checks for streams without them.

Add compact_string_view_columns and invoke it before FFI export in stream_next. Trigger compaction when a view column's allocated backing bytes exceed twice its used bytes and wasted space exceeds 10,240 bytes; otherwise return the original batch without copying. When triggered, call gc() on view columns and retain non-view columns.

Add unit tests for sliced StringView and BinaryView compaction, inline-only strings, empty arrays, non-view passthrough, and bloat detection. Use Arc::ptr_eq to verify that non-sliced batches retain their original columns.
Add an integration regression test that sends a 10,000-row StringView array sliced to 100 rows through df_stream_next and verifies 100 output rows with total backing buffers below 10,000 bytes.
Update the DiskUsageTests NodeStats helper call with the missing AnalyticsBackendNativeMemoryStats argument to restore compilation.

change_request.title: [Arrow Flight RPC] Add metadata channel on ArrowBatchResponse
change_request.author: rishabhmaurya

task.task: Add an opaque per-batch metadata channel to ArrowBatchResponse over native Arrow Flight without changing the public server stream-transport SPI or FlightTransportChannel API.
subtasks: Add an ArrowBatchResponse constructor accepting VectorSchemaRoot and optional byte[] metadata, expose getMetadata(), and read metadata from ArrowStreamInput. Provide a default-null ArrowStreamInput.getMetadata() and preserve existing constructors.

Thread response metadata through FlightOutboundHandler to FlightServerChannel.sendBatch. For non-null metadata, allocate an ArrowBuf using the channel allocator and send it with putNext(ArrowBuf); retain putNext() for batches without metadata.

Copy each frame’s getLatestMetadata() buffer into a consumer-owned byte[] in FlightTransportResponse, treating absent or empty buffers as null. Pass the bytes through native VectorStreamInput so responses retain metadata independently of the stream cursor; leave the byte-serialized path unchanged.
Add unit coverage for sending metadata and metadata-free batches, copying null/empty/populated metadata buffers, and update outbound-handler mocks for the metadata-aware sendBatch signature.

Add StreamMetadataIT coverage verifying exact metadata bytes appear once on the last batch when profiling is enabled, and no metadata appears when disabled, with batch and row counts preserved. Run arrow-base and arrow-flight-rpc checks plus StreamMetadataIT and NativeArrowTransportIT.
Document per-batch and last-batch metadata usage, action-owned encoding and decoding, and metadata lifetime in the native Arrow transport design; link it from the server-side streaming guide.

change_request.title: Fix breaking changes by delegating and deprecating
change_request.author: msfroh

task.task: Restore backward compatibility for legacy IndexModule.newIndexService overloads by delegating to newer APIs instead of throwing runtime exceptions.
subtasks: Replace UnsupportedOperationException in the two legacy overloads with delegation, supplying a no-op replicator, a null-returning replication-stats provider, and a null cluster merge scheduler configuration where omitted.

Guard cluster merge scheduler configuration access in IndexService so legacy calls with null configuration retain existing merge scheduler defaults without throwing NullPointerException.
Make IndexModule.indexReaderWrapper final.
Add a regression test in IndexModuleTests that creates an index service through the oldest legacy overload without throwing.

Add REST integration tests using an unsupported MATCH scalar function through /_analytics/ppl to verify HTTP 400, error type unsupported_function_exception, a clear function-specific message, and no leaked lucene or datafusion backend names.

change_request.title: Add interface for the Multi format merge flow
change_request.author: darjisagar7

task.task: Introduce initial experimental merge abstractions for the multi-data-format indexing engine.
subtasks: Add OneMerge with an unmodifiable segment list and cached totals for searchable-file sizes and row counts across data formats.

Add an abstract MergeHandler exposing merge selection, force-merge selection, and execution hooks. Manage a synchronized FIFO pending queue, validate segments against catalog snapshots, skip overlapping merges during queue updates, and clean up tracked segments on success or failure.

Add a MergeScheduler scaffold that refreshes concurrency limits from MergeSchedulerConfig, exposes placeholder trigger/force-merge methods and empty statistics, and reports unlimited I/O by default or 20 MB/s when auto-throttling is enabled.
Expose getNextWriterGeneration() on IndexingExecutionEngine and implement monotonically increasing generations in the composite engine and test stubs, sharing the composite writer pool's counter.

Extract shared mock data-format utilities and add tests covering merge metadata, queue ordering, catalog validation, overlap prevention, lifecycle callbacks, and scheduler configuration and throttling defaults.
Document the merge package and add a changelog entry.

change_request.title: Fix the regression of terms agg optimization
change_request.author: bowenlan-amzn

task.task: Fix the high-cardinality terms aggregation performance regression by limiting term-frequency precomputation and aligning streaming fallback decisions.
subtasks: Add and register the dynamic, node-scoped setting `search.aggregations.terms.max_precompute_cardinality` with a default of 30,000 and a minimum of 0; expose its value through SearchContext and DefaultSearchContext.
Skip GlobalOrdinalsStringTermsAggregator term-frequency precomputation when the segment term count is unknown or exceeds the configured threshold.
Update streaming cost estimation so the match-all, mostly-clean-segments fallback to traditional aggregation applies only when maximum cardinality is within the precompute threshold.

Set the default threshold in aggregation test contexts and add regression tests verifying that a zero threshold forces normal document collection with correct buckets, and that high-cardinality match-all queries remain streamable.
Add a changelog entry describing the high-cardinality terms aggregation regression fix.

Enable CONCAT and SAFE_CAST alongside CAST in DataFusion project capabilities, and register ConcatFunctionAdapter.

Implement the concat adapter as CASE WHEN any operand IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE original CONCAT END, preserving the original call and return type, folding null checks across operands, and leaving calls with fewer than two operands unchanged.
Add unit coverage for resolver branches and unknown operators, plus concat rewrite structure, operand references, typed NULL, return-type preservation, n-ary folding, and single-operand pass-through.

Add EvalCommandIT using the existing calcs dataset through POST /_analytics/ppl to cover literal-plus-field concatenation, integer-to-string casts, chained concatenation, and field combinations, including null results; verify fillnull and append regressions remain passing.

change_request.title: Wire coordinator queries into Rust query-tracking + cancellation
change_request.author: mch2

task.task: Integrate coordinator reduce queries with Rust query tracking and cancellation so cancelling an AnalyticsQueryTask cancels both shard scans and coordinator execution under the same task ID.
subtasks: Add a long taskId to ExchangeSinkContext and populate it from the parent task in local stage execution factories, using 0 when no parent exists. Forward it through streaming, memtable, and prepared-plan reduce paths.
Update NativeBridge method signatures, FFI descriptors, and Rust df_execute_local_plan / df_execute_local_prepared_plan entry points to accept a trailing context_id.

Register coordinator execution through QueryTrackingContext in the shared QUERY_REGISTRY. Wrap local Substrait planning and execution in cancellation::cancellable so cancellation interrupts work before the first batch; retain the prepared-plan context in QueryStreamHandle for cancellation during stream_next. Preserve context_id 0 as disabling tracking and token registration.

Add a Rust regression test verifying that reduce-path context creation registers a token, cancel_query fires it, and cancellable returns a cancellation error containing the context ID. Update Java tests and fixtures for the new signatures, and validate against the existing coordinator task-cancellation integration test.

change_request.title: Support expected remote cluster name in CCS sniff mode
change_request.author: varunbharadwaj

task.task: Support an optional expected remote cluster name in CCS sniff mode to prevent connections to unintended clusters through stale seeds.
subtasks: Add and register the dynamic, node-scoped setting cluster.remote.<alias>.cluster_name, supported only in sniff mode. Treat empty or whitespace-only values as unset.

Validate handshake cluster names against the configured expected name, rejecting mismatches with an informative error and continuing to the next seed. Preserve first-handshake cluster-name validation when the setting is unset.
Rebuild the sniff connection strategy when the normalized expected cluster name changes.
Expose the configured name as cluster_name in _remote/info sniff-mode responses when set. Include it in mode-info equality and hashing, and gate its transport serialization on version 3.5.0 or later.

Test mismatched-only seeds, fallback from a mismatched seed to a matching seed, successful matching connections and node discovery, and strategy rebuild behavior. Update existing tests for the constructor changes.
Add a changelog entry for expected cluster-name validation in CCS sniff mode.

change_request.title: Add module wiring and integration tests for WritableWarm tiered storage
change_request.author: MayankHarsh03

task.task: Wire WritableWarm tiered storage into the server and add integration coverage for warm index operations.
subtasks: In Node, initialize cluster-backed TieredStoragePrefetchSettings, register TieredDirectoryFactory for the tiered-storage composite store, and bind TierActionMetrics using the metrics registry, gated by WRITABLE_WARM_INDEX_EXPERIMENTAL_FLAG.

In IndicesService, initialize a cluster-backed prefetch settings supplier and register TieredStorageSearchSlowLog and StoredFieldsPrefetch as per-index search listeners when the feature flag is enabled.

change_request.title: Add timestamp filter support for queries in analytics core
change_request.author: vinaykpud

task.task: Support PPL timestamp-column filters in analytics core’s DataFusion backend by converting SQL-plugin TIMESTAMP(varchar) calls into literals that can be serialized to Substrait.
subtasks: Add TIMESTAMP to ScalarFunction and use OTHER_FUNCTION for name-resolved functions, excluding that kind from direct SqlKind lookup.

Register a DataFusion TimestampFunctionAdapter that converts single VARCHAR-literal calls using field mapping precision and leaves unsupported calls unchanged. Add a Substrait plan rewriter that recursively normalizes filter timestamp literals to millisecond precision, converting seconds, microseconds, and nanoseconds while preserving nullability and rejecting unsupported precisions.
Ensure table scans expose bare index names before Substrait conversion, replacing the converter’s catalog-prefix stripping.
Upgrade Substrait core and Isthmus to 0.89.1, migrate visitor construction to ConverterProvider, and update dependency checksums and audit exclusions.
Add unit tests for timestamp parsing, timezone normalization, fractional seconds, nested filter-literal rewriting, unchanged millisecond literals, unsupported precision, and bare table names.

change_request.title: Add node-level JVM and CPU runtime metrics
change_request.author: sakrah

task.task: Expose node-level JVM and CPU runtime metrics through the telemetry MetricsRegistry using pull-based gauges.
subtasks: Implement Closeable NodeRuntimeMetrics with gauges for heap used/committed/limit, non-heap used/committed, per-pool used/limit/used_after_last_gc, cumulative GC duration/count, buffer-pool used/capacity/count, total and per-state threads, current/total loaded and unloaded classes, JVM uptime, and process/system CPU utilization.

Use the supplied jvm.* metric names, bytes/s/1 units, and type/pool/gc/state tags. Discover memory pools, collectors, and buffer pools from the initial JvmStats snapshot; read current values through JvmService.stats() and return zero for missing named resources.

Reuse JvmService's cached snapshots and add a synchronized one-second cache for thread-state counts, with an injectable ThreadMXBean for testing. Convert durations to seconds and CPU percentages to ratios; clamp unavailable negative CPU values and undefined memory-pool limits to zero.
Validate constructor dependencies, clean up registered gauge handles if construction fails, and make close idempotent while continuing cleanup after handle IOExceptions.
Instantiate NodeRuntimeMetrics in Node using the existing metrics registry, JVM service, and process/OS probes, and add it to resourcesToClose.

Add unit coverage for gauge registration, names, units, tags, dynamic discovery, supplier values and conversions, thread-state counts, negative CPU values, constructor failure cleanup, and close behavior. Document the component in Javadoc and add a changelog entry.

change_request.title: Remove indexed-path tuning knobs
change_request.author: alchemist51

task.task: Simplify the DataFusion analytics backend’s indexed-query configuration, correct dynamic settings wiring, and consolidate shared per-query setup.
subtasks: Remove the query_strategy, dynamic_filter_pushdown, single_collector_strategy, tree_collector_strategy, max_collector_parallelism, and bloom_filter_on_read settings and their Java, FFM, and Rust fields. Always route QTF row-ID computation through the indexed executor, enable dynamic-filter and bloom-filter pruning, use PageRangeSplit for single collectors and TightenOuterBounds for trees, and fix collector parallelism at 1.

Rename datafusion.indexed.batch_size to datafusion.batch_size (default 8192) and datafusion.indexed.parquet_pushdown_filters to datafusion.listing_table.pushdown_filters (default false). Add dynamic node-scope datafusion.indexed.pushdown_filters (default true) and datafusion.indexed.force_strategy (none, row_selection, boolean_mask; default none), wiring initialization and update listeners through Java snapshots and FFM to Rust.

Remove the force_pushdown config and wire override; migrate tests to indexed_pushdown_filters while retaining the fuzz harness’s optional override. Apply force_strategy to the per-row-group min_skip_run decision and preserve existing pushdown safety checks.

Update WireConfigSnapshot serialization and WireDatafusionQueryConfig together, removing obsolete fields and matching field offsets through the 52-byte wire payload. Keep cost_predicate and cost_collector as fixed wire constants and continue deriving target_partitions from concurrent-segment-search settings.

Extract shared runtime/store setup, query tracking and memory-pool extraction, ListingTable registration with optional sort order, and session construction into helper.rs. Preserve indexed-only optimizer and UDF differences, extract disk-pressure and memory-budget resolution into resolve_effective_config, and consolidate imports.

Update and run Rust wire-conversion and affected end-to-end tests, plus Java snapshot, settings, property, plugin-registration, and dynamic-settings tests to reflect the reduced configuration and renamed settings.

task.task: Unblock common PPL multisearch queries on the DataFusion analytics backend by correcting Substrait root names, enabling CASE expressions, and typing implicit NULL branches before conversion.

Add MultisearchCommandIT on the analytics-engine REST route using scalar-only projections from the calcs dataset. Cover two- and three-branch aggregation, explicit CASE projection, count(eval(predicate)), and rejection of a single subsearch.
Run the converter and preprocessor unit tests, MultisearchCommandIT, the full analytics-engine REST integration suite, and sandbox check.

change_request.title: Update pull-based ingestion multi-threaded writer flow batchStartPointer computation
change_request.author: varunbharadwaj

task.task: Fix batchStartPointer computation in pull-based multi-threaded ingestion when a processor has not read its first queued message, and prevent concurrent Kafka consumer access during resets.
subtasks: Track each partition’s first queued message pointer before enqueueing and use it when the processor’s current shard pointer is null. Roll back newly recorded pointers if enqueueing fails, and clear tracking when queues are cleared or closed.
Capture the restart batchStartPointer before clearing queues during consumer reinitialization, while allowing an explicit reset pointer to override it.
Synchronize KafkaPartitionConsumer readNext overloads, pointer lookups, lag calculation, and close to serialize access to the underlying Kafka consumer.
Document the sequential enqueue ordering required by the first-queued-pointer fallback and remove outdated consumer thread-safety comments.
Add regression tests for the first-queued-pointer fallback, cleanup after enqueue failure, and preservation of the restart pointer across consumer reinitialization.
